title: Doubly-robust causal inference for multi-valued treatment regimes with recurrent neural networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.08077v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We propose a doubly-robust method to estimate the causal effects of multi-valued treatment regimes on patient outcomes. A multi-valued treatment regime assigns personalized treatments from a set of competing options based on a patient's history. Existing methods for optimal treatment regimes are largely limited to binary or continuous treatments. We extend the longitudinal targeted minimum loss-based estimator (LTMLE) to accommodate multi-valued treatments by modeling treatment assignments with a multinomial model. We further integrate recurrent neural networks (RNNs) into the LTMLE framework as learners for the outcome, treatment, and censoring models, and compare this approach to ensemble machine learning. Simulation studies show that LTMLE with either ensemble machine learning or RNNs is approximately unbiased, with close to nominal coverage, whereas sequential g-computation with ensemble machine learning is substantially biased und

translated_title: 基于循环神经网络的多值治疗方案双重稳健因果推断
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种双重稳健方法，用于估计多值治疗方案对患者结局的因果效应。多值治疗方案根据患者的病史从一组相互竞争的选项中为其分配个性化治疗。现有的最优治疗方法大多局限于二分类或连续型治疗。我们通过使用多项模型对治疗分配进行建模，将纵向目标最小损失估计器（LTMLE）扩展以适应多值治疗。我们进一步将循环神经网络（RNN）整合到LTMLE框架中，作为结局模型、治疗模型和删失模型的学习器，并将该方法与集成机器学习进行比较。模拟研究表明，无论采用集成机器学习还是RNN，LTMLE均近似无偏且覆盖率接近名义水平，而使用集成机器学习的顺序g-计算则存在显著偏差。
tldr: 该论文将循环神经网络融入扩展至多值治疗的纵向目标最小损失估计（LTMLE）框架，实现了对多值治疗方案因果效应的双重稳健估计，模拟结果显示该方法近似无偏且覆盖率接近名义水平。
en_tdlr: This paper integrates RNNs into an LTMLE framework extended for multi-valued treatments, achieving doubly-robust and approximately unbiased estimation of causal effects for multi-valued treatment regimes with near-nominal coverage.
